scripts.start: pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others --names server,client "pnpm run server" "pnpm run client"
scripts.start:vanilla: pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others --names world-1,client "pnpm --filter @august/server start:world -- --world=1" "pnpm --filter @august/client start"
scripts.server: pnpm --filter @august/server ensure-cache && pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others --names world-1,world-2 "pnpm --filter @august/server start:world -- --world=1" "pnpm --filter @august/server start:world -- --world=2"
scripts.check: pnpm check:structure && pnpm check:naming && pnpm check:boundaries && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:packages && pnpm typecheck:tools && pnpm --filter @august/server typecheck:all && pnpm --filter @august/client typecheck:all
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @august/server build && pnpm --filter @august/client build && pnpm docs:build
